notes.title: Major Update out: More Glitches, Steam Workshop support and much more! :D

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug where the game would crash when opening the inventory.

tags.balance_change: - Increased the damage of the shotgun by 10%.

tags.feature: - Added a new game mode: Capture the Flag.

tags.bug: - Resolved an issue where players could get stuck in the terrain.

tags.balance_change: - Reduced the cooldown of the special ability from 60 seconds to 45 seconds.
